purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Galole Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (form_download_ids confirmed against a fresh full-portal manifest discovery, single unambiguous match). The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake. This constituency's PDF carries an anomalous grey banner reading 'FORM 37 B' at the very top of every page (an apparent IEBC portal template/coversheet mislabel), but the form body itself is unambiguously the presidential Form 34B: page 1 is headed 'Form 34 B — COLLATION OF PRESIDENTIAL ELECTION RESULTS AT THE CONSTITUENCY TALLYING CENTRE, Name of Constituency: GALOLE, Code: 019, Name of County: TANA RIVER, Code: 004', the candidate columns are the four 2022 presidential candidates, and page 3 references 'Number of FORM 34A submitted/received' and the 'National Presidential Tallying Centre' handover block.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (GALOLE, code 019, county TANA RIVER code 004) was read explicitly from the page-1 form header ('Name of Constituency: GALOLE Code: 019', 'Name of County: TANA RIVER Code: 004') and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 019' banner marker printed on every page before this row was accepted, despite the anomalous 'FORM 37 B' grey coversheet banner described above.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-019-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile exactly on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 28,597 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (39,979) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (39,965). The printed Form 34B total includes one special-facility polling station with a non-ward code ('049292145101201 HOLA PRISON - 01', registered 14), exactly explaining the observed delta of 14. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West, Garissa Township, Mvita) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
